6c069694-7fea-4980-b59d-d9dc2c857cc4.content:
RESTORE POWER · ONE PLAYABLE QUEST

Start at Station. Check inventory or objectives through the two query jumpers, or choose a physical interaction. Ordinary responses return directly to Station. The powered exit ends the playthrough. All condition rows have one output.

e1d06b05-73ac-4040-97d1-04a6f8091204.content:
START HERE · PLAY MODE AND UNREAL

Two query choices use jumpers and leave game_event unchanged. Five gameplay labels set type and cell_id, then share the event router. Unreal injects these inputs, selects the branch connection, and refreshes its HUD after each event.

b7583d4b-fa40-4507-9057-7d2538281cc6.content:
TERMINAL · use_terminal

Accept the task once. Later visits show quest progress.

63297b78-e94e-4676-9e36-7dbdb9b02061.content:
GENERATOR · check_generator

Restore power after accepting the task and collecting enough cells. Then reach the exit.

567ce162-983d-43ba-b0d6-409dce845e18.content:
PICKUP · collect_cell

cell_id identifies cell_a or cell_b. Check its collected flag, then task acceptance. The accepted element marks the cell, increments inventory, and shows the new count. Unreal reads each cell's collected flag to hide its pickup and disable collision, including after loading a checkpoint.

c2b03497-1971-4bd0-815e-1025fae44a13.content:
OPTIONAL OBJECTIVES · AUTOMATIC UNREAL HUD

Station's Check current objective jumper enters this section. Reset quest_ui, apply shared powered overrides, then select the current objective and return to Station. Quest progress and event inputs are unchanged.

Unreal refreshes this same section automatically after every interaction, including the final exit. Use one Arcscript statement per code block.

8a1702ae-b5fe-44cb-bacd-97868065a17c.content:
EXIT · enter_exit

Entering the powered exit completes the task. Repeat entry only shows feedback.

8bea571f-426b-463c-81a7-d54c50c3855f.content:
OPTIONAL INVENTORY

Station's Check inventory jumper displays the carried power-cell count. This query only reads state and returns to Station. It does not collect a cell, change event inputs, or advance the quest.

Unreal effect

Opens the station exit gate through the sample's C++ command handler. Station lighting follows quest.power_restored separately.

When to reference

Reference this component on the successful generator activation element. The sample executes the element's Arcscript first, then dispatches its referenced action components using their custom IDs.

Arcweave Play Mode

The authored Arcscript and quest feedback still run. The physical gate movement is implemented in Unreal by the sample; this reference is not a built-in Arcscript command.
